pad_001: You can recognise it by its clump of about 25 slender stems inside a purpose-built octagonal glasshouse, rather than one trunk. It stands in the Orto Botanico di Padova.
pad_002: You can recognise it by its hollow trunk, split open from the base by a lightning strike, wide enough to see into. It stands in the Orto Botanico di Padova.
pad_003: You can recognise it by producing both pollen and foul-smelling fruit from the same trunk, the result of a 19th-century graft. It stands in the Orto Botanico di Padova.
pad_004: You can recognise it by its wide evergreen crown, about 13 metres across, with huge cream flowers opening a few at a time. It stands in the Orto Botanico, not the Basilica's magnolia 300 metres away.
pad_005: You can recognise it by its low branches resting on the ground, forming green walls that fill the courtyard rather than a crown overhead. It stands at the centre of the Chiostro della Magnolia, Basilica di Sant'Antonio.
pad_006: You can recognise it by its great height, about 48 metres, and trunk over 6 metres round, the largest of three protected trees within 60 metres of each other. It stands in Parco Treves de' Bonfili.
pad_007: You can recognise it by its trunk, just over 5 metres round, smaller than its neighbour the great plane about 60 metres away. It stands in Parco Treves de' Bonfili.
pad_008: You can recognise it by its low, leaning trunk and limbs spreading sideways over the grass instead of rising upright. It stands in Parco Treves de' Bonfili, easy to walk straight past.
pad_009: You can recognise them by the pair of trees standing about 20 metres apart, the larger 4.6 metres round, flowering cream in August. They stand in Piazza Capitaniato.
pad_010: You can recognise it by its conifer form among the garden's cedars, about 4.5 metres round, standing between the Montagnola hill and the Fontana delle Quattro Stagioni. It stands in the Orto Botanico di Padova.
pad_011: You can recognise it by its comparatively slim trunk, under a metre round, and narrow conical crown among broader trees nearby. It stands near the main path to the Orto Botanico's ticket office.
